result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection controlled by a traffic signal but lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure like marked crosswalks and curb ramps. The roadway surface is in poor condition with significant cracking, and parked vehicles near the corner may limit visibility for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection is controlled by a traffic light but lacks any painted crosswalks, making pedestrian movements less predictable to drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk ends at a vertical curb without a sloped transition, creating an accessibility barrier.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Extensive cracking and uneven patching in the roadway can create tripping hazards for pedestrians and cyclists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style painted crosswalks to clearly delineate pedestrian right-of-way at the signalized intersection.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install directional curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to ensure the intersection is accessible to all users.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines between motorists and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and curb ramps within a mixed-use urban environment. While basic infrastructure is present, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and the presence of parked cars near the crossing may impact safety.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners may block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the side street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The street features a wide roadway with basic marked crosswalks and traffic signals, but lacks advanced traffic calming measures. Pedestrian safety is compromised by significant visual obstructions from large vehicles and parked cars, as well as debris on the sidewalks.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large FedEx truck and parked vehicles block sightlines between pedestrians at the crosswalk and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Trash bags and bins are placed on the sidewalk and near the curb, narrowing the accessible path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace standard parallel line markings with continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection adjacent to a school building that lacks essential pedestrian infrastructure, such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While sidewalks are present, the roadway surface is in poor condition and sightlines are partially obstructed by parked vehicles near the corners.
